title: Record phase c aural exciter verification
description:
Write docs/verification/phase_c_aural_exciter.md only. Record that phase c Module B (Aural Exciter) was implemented and how it was verified.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY docs/verification/phase_c_aural_exciter.md.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/DSP/AuralExciter.h and Source/DSP/AuralExciter.cpp for actual symbols and behavior to document
- docs/verification/ for existing phase verification markdown format

Document must include:
- Phase goal summary: sidechain HP (EXC_TUNE 800 Hz–10 kHz), three wave-shapers, 2x/4x oversampling, Air EQ shelf, RT-safety constraints
- Files delivered: Source/DSP/AuralExciter.h, Source/DSP/AuralExciter.cpp
- Verification commands run (not make):
  - cmake -B cmake-build-debug -G Ninja
  - cmake --build cmake-build-debug --target AuralMaximizerPro_Standalone
  - cppcheck --enable=all Source/DSP
  - clang-format --dry-run --Werror on Source/DSP/AuralExciter.h and Source/DSP/AuralExciter.cpp
- Explicit notes: oversampler constructed/latency queried in prepare only; smoothed G/delta/gamma; no locks/allocations on audio thread
- Pass/fail table for each check

Do not modify source code.
acceptance_criteria: docs/verification/phase_c_aural_exciter.md documents cmake Ninja Standalone build, cppcheck, and clang-format checks
docs/verification/phase_c_aural_exciter.md states real-time safety constraints for oversampling and parameter smoothing
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: claim verification passed without listing the commands

allowed: write structured markdown verification report matching docs/verification style
forbidden: expand scope beyond phase c exciter verification
